{-# LANGUAGE ApplicativeDo #-}
module SafePaint where

import Daml.Script
import LockIou
import Iou (Amount(..))

data SafePaintIds = SafePaintIds {iouId: ContractId LockIou.LockableIou; paintId: ContractId PaintHouse}

template PaintHouse
  with
    painter: Party
    beneficiary: Party
  where
    signatory painter, beneficiary

template SafeOfferToPaintHouse
  with
    beneficiary: Party
    painter: Party
  where
    signatory painter
    observer beneficiary

    choice SafeAccept : SafePaintIds
      with
        iouId : ContractId LockIou.LockedIou
      controller beneficiary
        do
          iouId2 <- exercise iouId LockIou.Transfer
          paint <- create $ PaintHouse with painter; beneficiary
          return $ SafePaintIds {iouId = iouId2; paintId = paint}

safePainterOffersAndAliceAccepts =
  script do
    bank <- allocateParty "Bank"
    alice <- allocateParty "Alice"
    bob <- allocateParty "Bob"
    iouId <- submit bank $ do
        -- Creating an IOU also for Bob such that this transaction lands on the synchronizer where Bob is hosted too
        createCmd $ LockIou.LockableIou with payer = bank; owner = bob; amount = Amount {value = 1.0; currency = "USD"}
        iouId <- createCmd $ LockIou.LockableIou with payer = bank; owner = alice; amount = Amount {value = 100.0; currency = "USD"}
        pure iouId
    offerId <- submit bob do
        createCmd $ SafeOfferToPaintHouse with painter = bob; beneficiary = alice
    lockedIouId <- submit alice do
        exerciseCmd iouId LockIou.Assign with beneficiary = bob
    inp <- submit alice do exerciseCmd offerId SafeAccept with iouId = lockedIouId
    submit bob do exerciseCmd inp.iouId LockIou.Call

safePainterOffersAndAliceAcceptsWithCarol =
  script do
    bank <- allocateParty "Bank"
    alice <- allocateParty "Alice"
    carol <- allocateParty "Carol"
    iouId <- submit bank do
        -- Creating an IOU also for Carol such that this transaction lands on the synchronizer where Carol is hosted too
        createCmd $ LockIou.LockableIou with payer = bank; owner = carol; amount = Amount {value = 1.0; currency = "USD"}
        iouId <- createCmd $ LockIou.LockableIou with payer = bank; owner = alice; amount = Amount {value = 100.0; currency = "USD"}
        pure iouId
    offerId <- submit carol do
        createCmd $ SafeOfferToPaintHouse with painter = carol; beneficiary = alice
    lockedIouId <- submit alice do
        exerciseCmd iouId LockIou.Assign with beneficiary = carol
    inp <- submit alice do exerciseCmd offerId SafeAccept with iouId = lockedIouId
    submit carol do exerciseCmd inp.iouId LockIou.Call

safeTwoPainterOffers =
  script do
    safePainterOffersAndAliceAccepts
    safePainterOffersAndAliceAcceptsWithCarol

testIouIssueAndCall = script do
  bank <- allocateParty "Bank"
  alice <- allocateParty "Alice"
  stranger <- allocateParty "Stranger"
  submitMustFail bank do
    createCmd $ Iou with payer = bank; owner = alice; amount = (Amount with value = -0.01; currency = "USD"); viewers = []
  iou <- submit bank do
    createCmd $ Iou with payer = bank; owner = alice; amount = (Amount with value = 0.0; currency = "EUR"); viewers = []
  submitMustFail stranger do exerciseCmd iou Call
  submitMustFail bank do exerciseCmd iou Call
  cash <- submit alice do exerciseCmd iou Call
  cashData <- queryContractId alice cash
  case cashData of
    None -> assert False
    Some data_ -> do
      assert (data_.payer == bank)
      assert (data_.owner == alice)
      assert (data_.amount == Amount with value = 0.0; currency = "EUR")
  found <- queryContractId alice iou
  assert (found == None)
  submitMustFail alice do exerciseCmd iou Call

testIouTransferAndShare = script do
  bank <- allocateParty "Bank"
  alice <- allocateParty "Alice"
  bob <- allocateParty "Bob"
  carol <- allocateParty "Carol"
  dave <- allocateParty "Dave"
  iou <- submit bank do
    createCmd $ Iou with payer = bank; owner = alice; amount = usd; viewers = [carol]
  found <- queryContractId carol iou
  assert (found /= None)
  found <- queryContractId dave iou
  assert (found == None)
  submitMustFail bob do exerciseCmd iou Share with viewer = dave
  shared <- submit alice do exerciseCmd iou Share with viewer = dave
  found <- queryContractId alice iou
  assert (found == None)
  sharedData <- queryContractId dave shared
  case sharedData of
    None -> assert False
    Some data_ -> do
      assert (data_.payer == bank)
      assert (data_.owner == alice)
      assert (data_.amount == usd)
      assert (data_.viewers == [dave, carol])
  found <- queryContractId carol shared
  assert (found /= None)
  submitMustFail bob do exerciseCmd shared Transfer with newOwner = bob
  transferred <- submit alice do exerciseCmd shared Transfer with newOwner = bob
  found <- queryContractId alice shared
  assert (found == None)
  transferredData <- queryContractId bob transferred
  case transferredData of
    None -> assert False
    Some data_ -> do
      assert (data_.payer == bank)
      assert (data_.owner == bob)
      assert (data_.amount == usd)
      assert (data_.viewers == [])
  found <- queryContractId carol transferred
  assert (found == None)
  found <- queryContractId dave transferred
  assert (found == None)
  submitMustFail alice do exerciseCmd transferred Call
  cash <- submit bob do exerciseCmd transferred Call
  cashData <- queryContractId bob cash
  case cashData of
    None -> assert False
    Some data_ -> do
      assert (data_.payer == bank)
      assert (data_.owner == bob)
      assert (data_.amount == usd)

testLockableAssignAndCall = script do
  bank <- allocateParty "Bank"
  alice <- allocateParty "Alice"
  bob <- allocateParty "Bob"
  other <- allocateParty "Other"
  lockable <- submit bank do
    createCmd $ Lock.LockableIou with payer = bank; owner = alice; amount = usd
  submitMustFail other do exerciseCmd lockable Lock.Assign with beneficiary = bob
  submitMustFail bank do exerciseCmd lockable Lock.Assign with beneficiary = bob
  locked <- submit alice do exerciseCmd lockable Lock.Assign with beneficiary = bob
  found <- queryContractId alice lockable
  assert (found == None)
  lockedData <- queryContractId bob locked
  case lockedData of
    None -> assert False
    Some data_ -> do
      assert (data_.payer == bank)
      assert (data_.owner == alice)
      assert (data_.beneficiary == bob)
      assert (data_.amount == usd)
  submitMustFail alice do exerciseCmd lockable Lock.Call
  submitMustFail bob do exerciseCmd locked Lock.Transfer
  submitMustFail other do exerciseCmd locked Lock.Transfer
  reassigned <- submit alice do exerciseCmd locked Lock.Transfer
  found <- queryContractId alice locked
  assert (found == None)
  reassignedData <- queryContractId bob reassigned
  case reassignedData of
    None -> assert False
    Some data_ -> do
      assert (data_.payer == bank)
      assert (data_.owner == bob)
      assert (data_.amount == usd)
  submitMustFail alice do exerciseCmd reassigned Lock.Call
  cash <- submit bob do exerciseCmd reassigned Lock.Call
  cashData <- queryContractId bob cash
  case cashData of
    None -> assert False
    Some data_ -> do
      assert (data_.payer == bank)
      assert (data_.owner == bob)
      assert (data_.amount == usd)
  found <- queryContractId bob reassigned
  assert (found == None)

testLockedIouDirectAndRepeatedAssignment = script do
  bank <- allocateParty "Bank"
  alice <- allocateParty "Alice"
  bob <- allocateParty "Bob"
  carol <- allocateParty "Carol"
  locked <- submit bank do
    createCmd $ Lock.LockedIou with payer = bank; owner = alice; beneficiary = bob; amount = usd
  submitMustFail carol do exerciseCmd locked Lock.Transfer
  lockable <- submit alice do exerciseCmd locked Lock.Transfer
  lockableData <- queryContractId bob lockable
  case lockableData of
    None -> assert False
    Some data_ -> do
      assert (data_.payer == bank)
      assert (data_.owner == bob)
      assert (data_.amount == usd)
  submitMustFail alice do exerciseCmd lockable Lock.Assign with beneficiary = carol
  lockedAgain <- submit bob do exerciseCmd lockable Lock.Assign with beneficiary = carol
  lockedAgainData <- queryContractId carol lockedAgain
  case lockedAgainData of
    None -> assert False
    Some data_ -> do
      assert (data_.payer == bank)
      assert (data_.owner == bob)
      assert (data_.beneficiary == carol)
      assert (data_.amount == usd)
  submitMustFail carol do exerciseCmd lockedAgain Lock.Transfer
  finalIou <- submit bob do exerciseCmd lockedAgain Lock.Transfer
  finalData <- queryContractId carol finalIou
  case finalData of
    None -> assert False
    Some data_ -> do
      assert (data_.payer == bank)
      assert (data_.owner == carol)
      assert (data_.amount == usd)

testAmountAsText = script do
  assert (amountAsText usd == show usd.value <> "USD")
  assert (amountAsText (Amount with value = 0.0; currency = "EUR") == show (0.0 : Decimal) <> "EUR")
